summary: Seat of the Gonzaga court of Isabella d'Este (pe-isabella), where Leonardo stopped after leaving Milan in December 1499.

background.text: Patron saints: Saint Anselm of Lucca (feast 18 March), patron of the see. The cult of the Blessed Osanna Andreasi (d. 1505) was promoted by the Gonzaga
Government: Marquisate under the Gonzaga. Francesco II served the great powers as a condottiere while his wife Isabella d'Este conducted the diplomacy of culture: a double strategy of survival
Terrain and water: A natural fortress ringed on three sides by lakes formed by damming the Mincio
Economy and trade: A node among Venice, Milan, and the Papal States. Horse breeding and export; long distance trade in rarities through merchant networks reaching North Africa and beyond
